title: プロジェクトデザイン入門（実験）（心理情報デザイン学科）
subtitle: Design Project / Introduction
courseType: Design Project ProgramDesign Project CoursesDesign Project
educationalGoal:
-To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions.
-To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively.
-To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events.
-To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly.
-To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
-To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice:
In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes.
    This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department.
    One is that the students will learn the basis of data-handling skills (data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting) based on data science.
    One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities.
    For “data-handling skills”, students learn the way of thinking and the technique to quantify the mechanism of the human mind which is invisible, by psychological experiments (1. memory experiment, 2. kansei evaluation). They learn how to calculate the data, which were obtained in each experiment, and to visualize them as tables and figures, with Microsoft Excel. They also acquire the technique of utilizing tables and figures effectively when they have a presentation and write a report.
    For “PBL for science and technology”, students discuss any problems of the experiment theme which lecturers presented, then think how to improve the procedure of the experiment or a new experimental design.

requiredKnowledge:
Bring your laptop PC each time. You will use your laptop PC for almost all activities of the lecture (experiment, calculating the data, presentation, etc.).
Some research might be done for students to get a better understanding of psychological research and for lecturers to investigate any educational effects of the lecture. Whether students participate in the research or not will not affect their grade at all.
